items.title: Nvidia teams with Wall Street firms to help finance $500 billion for AI infrastructure
items.description: Nvidia late Monday announced a partnership with seven Wall Street financial institutions designed to raise more than $500 billion of third-party capital to fund the buildout of AI infrastructure.

items.title: ‘Her bank accounts were stripped bare by Medicaid’: My late friend had $20,000 in credit-card debt. Will her life insurance pay for it?
items.description: “She left behind a 30-year-old son and 32-year-old daughter.”

items.title: Rocket Lab reveals some big plans, but its stock is dropping on mixed earnings
items.description: The company is looking to expand its reach in Europe and building up its backlog.

items.title: This is the ZIP code with the hottest housing market in the country right now
items.description: Today’s residential real-estate market is not for the weak, observes one buyer in what Realtor.com is calling America’s hottest ZIP code.

items.title: EBay may dodge a GameStop takeover — but there’s a new twist in the Ryan Cohen saga
items.description: Bloomberg says GameStop could propose collaborating with eBay in some way other than a merger. Some analysts doubt whether eBay would benefit much from that sort of deal.

items.title: Archer strikes deal with Boeing in latest bid to transform aviation through AI
items.description: Archer Aviation’s stock is flying higher after the company agreed to buy three business units from Boeing.

items.title: Apple’s stock could underperform, especially without an ‘all-glass’ iPhone, this analyst warns
items.description: A Jefferies analyst says that it may be harder than it looks for Apple to roll out dramatically more expensive devices in a bid to boost profitability.

items.title: Intel plans to sell $15 billion worth of stock after it has risen 400% in a year
items.description: The company said it sees growth opportunities in physical AI, custom chips and advanced packaging.

items.title: This Nvidia change could spell good news for Micron
items.description: An analyst says that Nvidia’s move to downgrade some chip capabilities could end up boosting consumption of high-bandwidth memory.

items.title: SpaceX’s stock moves above its IPO price for the first time in almost a month
items.description: SpaceX shares have been clawing their way back in recent days but remain well off their highs.
